name: Talk files
responsibility: Keeps voice and one exact legacy or canonical playback payload for offline replay.
description: Every recording keeps its talk under the state directory's recordings, where the newest 10 stay. --talk keeps it in a new directory of its own that is never pruned. A place that already exists is refused before anything starts. A talk read back must parse as a talk and its voice.wav must hold as many samples as talk.json says, or it is refused before a browser starts.
